What the model does One fitted parameter

The tracked book underside prescribes an upper boundary. Foam stays below it and relaxes toward resting height without contact.

h_free = H − (H − h) exp(−Δt / τ)
h_next = min(h_free, book_height)

Dots follow uniform vertical scaling about the table. Length and width stay fixed. Observed foam motion scores predictions; it does not drive them.

The baseline uses h = min(H, book_height), returning instantly on release. Both models use identical input reconstruction and valid observations.

Measured motion versus prediction Vertical displacement
● Observed dot displacement— Model prediction

Displacement is relative to this dot's resting reference at the interval start. All initialized dots can be selected; the default is the first initialized dot, not the best-fitting one. Only observations included by the scoring mask are drawn. This is material-dot motion, not a measurement of the whole foam height.

Exploratory mean displacement Select material dots

Choose the same fixed group for both curves. Each dot's displacement is measured from its own resting reference. Percentages beside the dots show availability under the existing scoring mask, not tracking accuracy.

● Observed mean · all selected dots required— Predicted mean · same fixed group

Whenever any selected observation is missing, no observed mean is drawn. Predictions remain visible through those gaps. Selection resets when changing press. This chart does not change the fitted model or reported metrics.

Exploratory comparison: selecting dots after inspecting their agreement does not validate greater model accuracy. A mean can hide local errors; use the individual-dot graph and video to inspect tracking.

Assumptions, limitations & research context

This reduced proxy excludes inertia, local strain, lateral bulging, force prediction and permanent deformation. τ is an effective recovery time; separate stiffness and damping are not identified. Deep compression and nonuniform strain can cause systematic marker errors. Tracking coverage does not establish tracking accuracy.

The 3D shape is a dimensioned box, not a reconstruction. Gaussian Splatting motivates fitting through projected image observations; we use material-marker projection without Gaussian rendering. The hybrid particle–voxel paper motivates action-conditioned state evolution; we use an explicit reduced state without its network. These are conceptual connections, not reproductions.

Recovery-only metrics use observed book/marker gap >1 mm and marker-height proxy below H−0.3 mm. Small sample counts and the uniform-strain proxy limit interpretation. Full-interval marker error is the primary displayed metric.
